# Request Eagle

> Request Eagle is a native, open-source API client for macOS, Windows and Linux: a Postman alternative written in Rust that keeps requests as Git-friendly TOML files on your disk, with scripts, Vim mode, an agent panel for Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode, and a CLI for agents.

## Pages

- [Landing](https://requesteagle.tokarev.work/): What Request Eagle is and what it can do
- [Download](https://requesteagle.tokarev.work/downloads/): The latest stable release for Apple Silicon Macs, Windows and Linux
- [Compare](https://requesteagle.tokarev.work/compare/): Request Eagle beside Postman, Insomnia, Bruno, Yaak and Hoppscotch in one table
- [Request Eagle vs Postman](https://requesteagle.tokarev.work/compare/postman/): A native, open-source Postman alternative compared feature by feature
- [Request Eagle vs Insomnia](https://requesteagle.tokarev.work/compare/insomnia/): Compared with Kong's Insomnia
- [Request Eagle vs Bruno](https://requesteagle.tokarev.work/compare/bruno/): Compared with Bruno, the file-based Electron client
- [Request Eagle vs Yaak](https://requesteagle.tokarev.work/compare/yaak/): Compared with Yaak, the Tauri client
- [Request Eagle vs Hoppscotch](https://requesteagle.tokarev.work/compare/hoppscotch/): Compared with Hoppscotch, the browser-based client

## Guides

- [Request scripts](https://github.com/gregor-tokarev/request-eagle/blob/main/docs/scripting.md): Pre-request and post-response JavaScript with the `pm` API
- [Collection Runner](https://github.com/gregor-tokarev/request-eagle/blob/main/docs/collection-runner.md): Run a collection's requests in order, with iterations and data files
- [Flows](https://github.com/gregor-tokarev/request-eagle/blob/main/docs/flows.md): Chain saved requests on a canvas, with branches and loops
- [Git](https://github.com/gregor-tokarev/request-eagle/blob/main/docs/git.md): Track, commit, pull and push collections from the app
- [Agent](https://github.com/gregor-tokarev/request-eagle/blob/main/docs/agent.md): The agent panel for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode
- [CLI](https://github.com/gregor-tokarev/request-eagle/blob/main/docs/cli.md): The command-line interface for agents, without the desktop app
- [Source code](https://github.com/gregor-tokarev/request-eagle): The repository on GitHub
